bugs.title: 7th KPI label 'CSAT response rate' is truncated at 1440px
bugs.evidence:
At 1440x900 the

label in kpi-card for CSAT response rate has scrollWidth > clientWidth (ellipsized). KpiStrip.tsx line 38 uses 'truncate'. No backend (mock data) - frontend-only; screenshot p8-refunds-fraud-panels-typo.png. All other assertions in this check passed.

Ticket volume chart line reaches the right edge of the plot (pathRight 1380 vs grid 1384, axis ends Oct 25) - no early-stop issue.
Article editor on phone keeps the bottom tab bar visible (only conversation hides it); not asserted as a bug since the criterion only says 'full-screen editor'.
